verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a CLI-first tool with docker/homebrew/go install, distinct scan modes (git/dir/stdin) usable in scripts, exit codes on findings for CI gating ("Detect hardcoded secrets...Failed"), and a dedicated GitHub Action (gitleaks-action) for automated PR/commit scanning in CI. Missing for 10: evidence of official first-party CI integrations beyond GitHub Actions (e.g., GitLab CI, CircleCI templates) and independent hands-on CI usage reports.
